turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What can I do for you today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um yeah, so I'm here because I've had this fever, this cough, and now my head hurts. That's been going on for about the past four days and I just want to make sure um it's nothing too serious.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, yeah, that's great. So can you tell me, have you, did you measure your temperature?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I haven't actually measured it, I just feel hot and feel chills.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, but we can take your vitals here um and uh you you said that you've had a cough for the past four days, dry cough or wet cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um it's been pretty dry.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um, any uh no blood or any um sputum um coming up right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and has the the cough gotten worse or better or the same, has it been the same since the past four days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um it's it's actually getting worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, is there anything that makes it better or worse?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uh have you tried anything for your cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I've tried like decongest like cough suppressants but it doesn't seem to have helped.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. OK, and then tell me about your headache. That started four days ago as well?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And uh where exactly is it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: So it's like just on the front part of my head.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And does it feel like uh, what does it feel like? Is it like a throbbing sensation? A band like sensation? Um is it sharp, is it dull?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh it feels pretty throbbing right now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Is it both sides or on the uh left or right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh it's it seems like it's both sides.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: If you had to give it a number from 1 to 10 with 10 being the most severe pain ever, what number would you give it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I would give it about like a seven.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh wow, OK. And how's it changed over the past four days?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, it's just gotten a little bit worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um is it uh is it, what was I gonna say, is it constant or does it come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um It seems pretty it seems pretty constant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you taken anything for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I tried like some Tylenol for it and it seems to help a little bit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Does it, is there a certain time of the day when it's worse? Before going to bed, at the end of the day, waking up, anything like that?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had a similar headache in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh yeah, I guess I have, a little bit in the past, but that was also when I was like sick.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Sure, um does it wake you up in the middle of the night?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, it hasn't woken me up.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um I guess other than the headache, I'll ask you about, and the cough and fever, I'll ask you if you've had any other symptoms. So have you had any confusion?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, no confusion.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any changes in your vision or your hearing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um any um redness in your eyes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any loss of taste or loss of smell?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Um any runny nose or stuffy nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any sore throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any chest pain or difficulties breathing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any palpitations? Do you feel like your heart's racing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any belly pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No belly pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any aches or pains in your body?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Uh any rashes that you've noticed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no rashes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any discolouration of your fingers or toes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright um and do you have any medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I think I'm healthy otherwise.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, alright and have you had any hospitalizations or surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, um what about medications? Are you taking any? Over the counter or otherwise?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh I take some multivitamins, that's it though.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any family history of lung or heart problems uh or anything else, or cancers?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: And do you currently live alone or do you live with someone else or with other people?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I live with um my husband and our our daughter.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any, have you traveled anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not recently.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you uh, what do you mean by recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh like I have traveled in the past two years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, that's fine, that's fine. Have you had any contact with anyone who might be sick? Either you or your husband or your daughter?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you gone out of the home at all?

turns.text: Do you wear a mask and maintain social distancing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yes.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um alright, uh do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how, I guess how often would you say?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh once a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um no, not anymore.

turns.text: Uh how much did you smoke in the past?

turns.text: I I'd have like half a pack, um but I only smoked between like the age of 20 to like 25.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Do you smoke marijuana or have any edibles with marijuana in it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK um alright well uh, and you said that you don't have a family history of any problem?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah OK, alright, I think that's all the questions I had for you. So uh looks like you've had a fever, cough, and a um and a headache that's gotten worse in the past four days and your headache's pretty bad, a seven out of ten. Um and uh it could be that you have uh some sort of an infection, uh including um, with Covid being one of the possibilities, and so um continue to take Tylenol and and um monitor your uh fever. If it continues to get worse, or you um notice that your symptoms are just not getting better, um you should come back, you should uh, we'll also do a Covid, we'll also send in a request for a Covid swab. Um and uh we'll ask you to quarantine for the for the next 14 days and try to stay away from your husband and daughter as well, if you can at home. Um and uh I guess a couple of other questions that I wanted to ask and I should have asked earlier, do you have any um any stiffness in your neck or any difficulties moving your neck?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh no, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK alright, and um do you have any questions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh No, that's it. Thank you so much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Great.
